card.name: Inside numbers: separators and digits
card.fires_on: The decimal point, thousands comma, space or next digit partway through a written number, right after the first digits. It is seen in prices, statistics, dates and ranges.

modes.label: Decimal point in a number
modes.description: The period between whole and fractional digits of a figure such as a rate, price or measurement.

modes.label: Comma or digit inside a figure
modes.description: A thousands comma or a middle digit in a number or range, where more digits are expected.

modes.label: Space before a date or count
modes.description: A space after a month or "approximately" just before the number comes.

card.writes: It mostly suppresses ordinary word-like tokens, which fits the next token being a digit, but the effect is not clear.
card.plain: It marks the middle of a number, where the next piece must be more digits.
